fact: Law Lab Africa states that no supervisory authority has been established in Eritrea, as of 1 August 2026.
Law Lab Africa states that no enforcement decisions could be found for Eritrea and none are published, as of the 1 August 2026 verification pass.

The Horn of Africa Initiative Digital Policy Matrix update (June 2025) states that Eritrea remains without regulatory oversight for data protection, while Kenya, Somalia and Ethiopia have established supervisory authorities.
Levellers' legal-status page, last reviewed 8 June 2026, states Eritrea has no data protection statute and has not appointed a data protection authority.
Levellers states there is no privacy supervisory authority and no data protection authority to register with or appeal to, so none issues rulings (page reviewed 8 June 2026).
Data Protection Africa (ALT Advisory) fact sheet states Eritrea has no data protection legislation and no data protection authority yet appointed.
The fact sheet records no law and no authority, so no authority report or published figures exist (annual report and public report both 'No law'); date is the page's last-updated date, 24 May 2022.
